card.title: Back When I Was Ahead
card.instruction: Interpret the present through a time when you felt more successful, admired, or certain of your place.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: This old sales chart shows what I'm capable of.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's from before we sold online.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then let's take the website down for a fair comparison.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll put your phone number on the checkout page.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put my photograph there too. In my best year people asked for me, not a basket.

mechanism: A interprets online selling through a past peak defined by customers asking personally for A.
confusable: Unlike resisting technology generally, the objection and proposed fix must point to lost personal success.
comparison: S206-b accepts checkout contact if it restores personal recognition; S206-a asks to restore winning quiz conditions.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
